game.star_realms.name: Star Realms
game.star_realms.desc: Build a personal deck of ships and bases, spend trade to recruit from the shared row and combat to tear down your rivals' authority.
game.star_realms.rule.1: Every player starts with 50 authority, eight Scouts and two Vipers.
game.star_realms.rule.2: Draw a hand of five and play it: trade buys cards from the shared trade row, combat destroys bases and authority.
game.star_realms.rule.3: Bought cards go to your discard pile; when the deck runs out, the discard pile is shuffled into a new deck.
game.star_realms.rule.4: An outpost must fall before its owner can be attacked, and ally abilities fire as soon as a second card of that faction is in play.
game.star_realms.rule.5: Reduce every opponent's authority to zero to win the match.

sr.set.sr_core.name: Core Set
sr.set.sr_core.desc: The original 80-card Star Realms trade deck: Scouts, Vipers and the four factions that started it all.
sr.set.sr_mercenary_garrison.name: Mercenary Garrison
sr.set.sr_mercenary_garrison.desc: The promo outpost that recruits a free card draw when another Star Empire card is in play.
sr.set.sr_colony_wars.name: Colony Wars
sr.set.sr_colony_wars.desc: A standalone 80-card trade deck with all-new ships, bases and the acquire-to-hand mechanic.
sr.set.sr_crisis_bases.name: Crisis: Bases & Battleships
sr.set.sr_crisis_bases.desc: Twelve new ships and bases that reward playing a base-heavy fleet.
sr.set.sr_crisis_fleets.name: Crisis: Fleets & Fortresses
sr.set.sr_crisis_fleets.desc: Twelve new ships and bases, from the one-cost Spike Pod to the eight-cost Capitol World.
sr.set.sr_crisis_events.name: Crisis: Events
sr.set.sr_crisis_events.desc: Twelve event cards that resolve the moment they enter the trade row and are then scrapped.
sr.set.sr_crisis_heroes.name: Crisis: Heroes
sr.set.sr_crisis_heroes.desc: Twelve inexpensive heroes: they enter play when bought and are scrapped for one-time abilities.
sr.set.sr_united_assault.name: United: Assault
sr.set.sr_united_assault.desc: Twelve multi-faction ships and bases that belong to two factions at once.
sr.set.sr_united_command.name: United: Command
sr.set.sr_united_command.desc: Twelve more multi-faction ships and bases from the United series.
sr.set.sr_united_heroes.name: United: Heroes
sr.set.sr_united_heroes.desc: Twelve expensive heroes with an extra ability that fires when they are acquired.
sr.set.sr_frontiers.name: Frontiers
sr.set.sr_frontiers.desc: A standalone 80-card trade deck built around the double-ally mechanic.
sr.set.sr_promos.name: Promo Cards
sr.set.sr_promos.desc: Prize-support and deck-box promos such as the Mercenary Garrison; the exact card list varies by event.

sr.picker.required_note: The core set is always part of a match.
